text:
maria: Heads up — planning to start the v2 rollout at 06:00 UTC in ~15m. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% over 20m, then evaluate for 50%. Deploybot will toggle route:v2=true.
sam: Are we aware of any clients that need to be held on v1? Need to lock the exclusion list before we start.
maria: Olivia, can you confirm client pin list? I want to avoid surprises during the window.
olivia: Quick check — no enterprise pins requested for this window. Two tenants (acme-inc, beta-sandbox) asked to stay on v1 until Monday, but they didn't request a hard pin.
jen: Release notes are posted in the docs draft. I added a downgrade path and a short 'what's different' snippet:
```
- v2: stricter content-encoding negotiation
- SDKs: accept header keys case-insensitively
- Known: some clients may need minor header handling fixes
```
liam: SRE/ops: rollback criteria we agreed on — error rate > 1.5% (5m rolling) OR p50 latency +300ms sustained for 5m. Also watch gateway 4xx spikes and auth failure rates.
maria: Good. Deploybot, kick off canary when ready.
deploybot: [automated] initiating rollout: route=v2 split=5% -> 25% over 20m. canary_id=cb-440123. operator: @maria
sam: One safety question — if client-signal header indicates older SDK behavior, do we auto-fallback to v1 or keep routing with degraded telemetry?
maria: Policy: header pin -> route to v1. For errors that match rollback criteria, we do an immediate full rollback to v1 and abort subsequent stages. For degraded telemetry but below thresholds, we'll pause and investigate.
olivia: I'll notify SDK owners to ship a tiny tolerate-case-insensitive-headers patch; should be quick.
liam: Telemetry checklist for this window: per-tenant error rate, auth_failure count, latency histograms, and request schema mismatch logs. I'll pin dashboards and alert thresholds.
maria: If the 25% stage looks stable at the 25min mark, we publish the change window note and send release notes out to customers in the next hour.
jen: Added an operator helper snippet for quick rollback in the ops runbook:
```
# rollback to v1 for canary
./deploybot rollback --canary cb-440123 --reason "error-rate"
```
sam: I'll be on call for the first 90 minutes post-rollout and available for a manual rollback if needed.
maria: Thanks. Pinging #oncall as well. :thumbsup:
deploybot: [automated] canary stage completed: 5% -> 25%. monitoring active. next stage pending operator go/no-go.
deploybot: [automated] no immediate alerts triggered; continuing to observe.
liam: SRE => metrics stable for 10m, no auth spikes; error rate flat.
maria: SRE gives go. Proceeding to 50% in 10m unless objections.
olivia: SDK team green from our end.
maria: Proceeding. Will post here if we abort or roll back.
